Secondo la WHO 2021 «glioblastoma» si us:
According to WHO 2021, "glioblastoma" is used only for IDH wild-type gliomas. An IDH-mutant glioma with necrosis or microvascular proliferation is a grade 4 IDH-mutant astrocytoma: it affects younger adults, often in the frontal lobe, with a large non-enhancing portion and a relatively small enhancing component; the prognosis is better than glioblastoma.
Radiological clues to IDH mutation: young age, frontal location, sharper margins, large non-enhancing component, little necrosis, T2-FLAIR mismatch sign (in lower grades). The diagnosis remains histological and molecular.
